## Why
The first deploys go to a personal account. The site is static files with no backend, so the free plan should cover it.

## Steps
1. Create or sign in to a personal Cloudflare account. Stay on the free plan.
2. Note the account id from the dashboard.
3. Create an API token from the "Edit Cloudflare Workers" template, scoped to this one account.
4. Store the token and account id in a password manager. Do not commit either.

## Done when
- `npx wrangler whoami` shows the personal account when run with the token.
